content.short: Chainstack Subgraphs provides a single point of access for all your data across any blockchain.
content.description: Chainstack Subgraphs eliminates the complexity of extracting and processing data from archive nodes by offering an intuitive UI for Web3 developers to filter and query data. When you deploy a subgraph and configure the query criteria, all successful hits are indexed and stored in a PostgreSQL database, simplifying downstream analytics and tooling. A GraphQL endpoint is created to access the most recent data from the subgraph, synchronized to the latest block, providing a current, queryable view of your data.
